symptoms: Yellow pustules arranged in linear stripes on leaf surface.
organic_remedy: Neem oil spray (5ml/liter) and bio-control using Trichoderma harzianum.
chemical_remedy: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/liter of water at initial symptom appearance.
regenerative_advice: Rotate with non-cereal crops like Chickpea to disrupt fungal spores.

symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with grayish centers on leaves and neck nodes.
regenerative_advice: Maintain balanced nitrogen application; avoid excess urea in humid weather.

symptoms: Yellowing and drying of plants forming circular patches known as hopper burn.
organic_remedy: Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) irrigation; neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/liter.
regenerative_advice: Promote spider & mirid bug natural predator conservation by avoiding broad-spectrum sprays.

symptoms: Upward or downward curling of leaves with enation on under-surface veins.
organic_remedy: Control whitefly vector using yellow sticky traps (15 traps/acre) and Neem seed kernel extract.
regenerative_advice: Plant border rows of Maize or Sorghum to block whitefly migration.
